findings.staleAliasesOrDuplicateCoverage: None found — every server test:* script maps 1:1 or N:1 (test:auth, test:instagram, test:meta-wa chain 2-4 files each under one script name) to an existing file; no two script names point at overlapping-but-different file sets.
findings.scriptsThatSilentlySkipExpectedTests: The aggregate `npm run test` chain (server) does not run: the 6 pre-existing orphans above, the 8 never-scripted files (see ownership-gaps artifact), or any of the 8 dbVerification/DB-dependent scripts (by design — these require a disposable Postgres/MinIO the ordinary task/CI environment does not provide) — see testsOnlyReachableThroughGlobalSuite below for the inverse case.

packageScriptsAddedSinceF0005.note: This list is broader than the F0-005-vs-now test-file delta because several scripts (e.g. test:dental-chart-clinic-scope, test:reports-clinic-scope) were added for files that ALSO already existed as an add in the F0-005-to-now window — i.e. script and file were added together, consistent with normal development practice, not a stale reference.

findings.testsOnlyReachableThroughGlobalSuite: None — every backend file that IS in the aggregate `test` chain is ALSO independently runnable via its own named script (server/package.json defines one script per file, then chains them). There is no case in this repository of a test only reachable by running the full `npm run test` with no standalone script.

testsNotReachableThroughAnySuite.note: These 8 files have zero package.json script of any kind (individual or aggregate) and are runnable only via a direct `npx tsx <path>` invocation. 5 of these 8 were already unscripted at F0-005 (channelConsentGate, clinicLegalProfile, patientSharedPhone, platformBackup, treatmentPackagePermissions); aiPrivacyBoundary (the 6th F0-005 orphan) gained a script since and is no longer in this list; 3 are newly-added files that never received a script (kvkkHigh006Batch2ClinicScope, metaWhatsAppPostBookingHandler, planLimitsTargetClinicFix).
